title: Rendered Single-Service Estimates Awaiting a Final Bill — Medical Hardship Costs
content:
Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), care given under a rendered estimate is added to the qualifying medical debt documented with the other medical costs.

**Rendered estimate.** The patient's Good Faith & Price Estimates self-pay good faith estimate for a single scheduled service whose service has been completed (the estimate listed first among the patient's estimates when several are), while its linked Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account carries no self-pay final-bill liability. Its Riverbend lines are the convening-facility and convening-professional lines of its current version, and that account's unbilled charges are the charges posted on it less its self-pay final-bill liabilities.

**Addition, in one of three ways.**
- Linked account coded emergency or medically necessary: the smaller of its Riverbend lines and the program's amounts-generally-billed percentage (34.6 percent on every tier) of that account's unbilled charges, rounded half-up to the cent, is added.
- Linked account coded elective: its Riverbend lines are added.
- Otherwise nothing is added for a rendered estimate.

**Hypothetical.** Riverbend lines 1,500.00; unbilled charges 4,000.00, of which 34.6 percent is 1,384.00. Emergency coding adds 1,384.00; elective coding adds 1,500.00. Once a self-pay final-bill liability is posted on the linked account, the estimate is no longer a rendered estimate and nothing is added.
